verdict.rationale: Square documents a Payouts API that lists payouts filtered by location, status, and time range. That gives merchant-ops its own first-party view of payouts to reconcile against. Nothing in the pack shows itemized payout entries, per-transaction fee breakdowns, or daily takings reports that tie sales to payouts. Missing for 10: itemized transaction-to-payout mapping, fee reports, daily sales/takings reports, an end-to-end reconciliation workflow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports

citations.quote: Learn how to filter payouts by location ID, status, and time range and sort them in ascending or descending order.
